caption: A glass of water is placed on a line drawn on a piece of paper, and the line under the glass appears broken from the line outside it.

sa.check: A line is drawn on a piece of paper.
A glass of water is placed on it.
The line under the glass appears broken from the line outside it.
The glass is placed first and the break appears with it.

pc.expect: The apparent break is at the glass edges and the line returns to one straight line when the glass is lifted.
pc.fail: The break is away from the glass; or the line is unbroken under the glass; or the break stays after the glass is lifted.

pc.expect: The paper and its line are unchanged; the break is an appearance.
pc.fail: The drawn line moves; or the paper bends; or a second line appears.

pc.expect: The glass is rigid and the water level.
pc.fail: The glass bends; or the water tilts and holds; or goes opaque.

pc.expect: The glass and the paper stay put unless moved.
pc.fail: The glass slides; or the paper moves; or the image shifts with both still.
The glass duplicates; or the paper vanishes; or the glass passes through the paper.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The paper and the glass stay the same.
pc.fail: The paper changes colour; or the glass changes shape; or the table changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
